question: Should autoreview trust `data` and `providerConfig` as JavaScript/TypeScript source-reference roots, and should this narrow fix close the broader linked scanner issue?
rationale: The implementation can be mechanically correct while still changing the repository's intentional fail-closed disclosure policy, and the linked issue describes broader behavior than the patch implements.

options.title: Approve Narrow Boundary
options.body: Accept the two dialect-scoped roots and hardening, but revise the closing linkage so the broader issue remains tracked.

options.title: Require General Policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a general safe-reference or redaction policy covering the linked issue consistently.

options.title: Keep Existing Roots
options.body: Decline the new roots and require affected callers to use already-supported reference shapes.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the two dialect-scoped roots and hardening, but revise the closing linkage so the broader issue remains tracked.
